evals.name: kmctl-decisions
evals.expected_output: A report-only audit of .okf/decisions/ scoped from kmctl review due --json, with one verdict per record and a findings JSON block.
expectations: The due list comes from kmctl review due --json and only decisions/ are kept
Nothing under .okf/ or docs/ is changed and no verified entry is written
The findings block matches the shape in sample-findings.json
It reports that ADR 0002 claims the briefing names skills, which it does not
It reports the decision_status and decided_on fields that no ADR allows
It reports the records with no Consequences section

evals.name: loopharness-architecture
evals.expected_output: A report-only audit of the 10 .okf/architecture/ pages, each drifted claim cited with path:line on both sides, and a findings JSON block.
expectations: The due list comes from kmctl review due --json and only architecture/ pages are kept
Nothing in the repository is changed
Every drifted claim cites the page line and the code line
An independent check of each drifted claim against the code finds it real
A list the page presents as complete is checked against the code (loop-state, command-surface)

evals.name: loopharness-practices
evals.expected_output: A report-only audit of the 8 .okf/practices/ pages; a page whose evidence is not in the checkout is unsure with what would settle it, never holds.
expectations: The due list comes from kmctl review due --json and only practices/ pages are kept
Nothing in the repository is changed
A page whose sources are missing is marked unsure, with what would settle it
Each drifted or holds verdict cites path:line evidence
